senses.zh_definition: Rhodes：外语专名，可指希腊罗得岛及其同名城市；原始词项是否采用此义尚未确定。
senses.en_definition: Rhodes: a Greek island and its principal city; an unconfirmed interpretation of the supplied token.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi sebuah pulau di Greece dan bandar utamanya; padanan ini belum dapat dipastikan bagi token yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 地理所指有可靠依据，但不等于已确认输入的目标义。此处马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 官方释文；所列组合为专名用法，不主张其语料频率。[希腊国家旅游机构：Rhodes](https://www.visitgreece.gr/en/mainland/islands/rhodes)

senses.zh_definition: Rhodes：人名中的姓氏，例如 Cecil Rhodes；也见于以其命名的罗德奖学金。
senses.en_definition: Rhodes: a surname, as in Cecil Rhodes, also used in the name of the Rhodes Scholarship.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga, seperti dalam nama Cecil Rhodes, yang turut digunakan pada nama Biasiswa Rhodes.
senses.nuances: 这是另一种有依据的专名用法，不能由输入的裸词直接判定。Biasiswa Rhodes 整体指奖学金，Rhodes 单独并不具有“奖学金”的普通词义；此处释文为编辑说明。[Rhodes Trust：奖学金](https://www.rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk/scholarships/)；[牛津大学：奖学金命名背景](https://www.campaign.ox.ac.uk/rhodes)

etymology.historical_story: Rhodes enters this entry as an unresolved proper name rather than a verified Malay common word. One established reference is the Greek island; another is the surname commemorated by the Rhodes Scholarship, established through Cecil Rhodes's will in 1902. These references must remain distinct until the original context identifies the intended one. [希腊国家旅游机构](https://www.visitgreece.gr/en/mainland/islands/rhodes)；[牛津大学](https://www.campaign.ox.ac.uk/rhodes)
